subject: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>, Emily Wong <emily.wong@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps

Hi Samir / Emily —

Great to meet you both earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery + a few asks to make sure your trial-to-paid path is frictionless: 

1) Trial objectives + success criteria:
- Confirmed: evaluate inference latency/cost for a production prompt set and validate caching impacts across your pipelines.
- Ask: please share the 3–5 representative prompts and an expected daily token/hour throughput for the pilot.

2) Procurement preference:
- You mentioned procurement prefers a PO for enterprise purchases. We can accept PO (monthly invoice) or card for smaller pilots.
- Attach: Redwood-SOW-template.pdf + PO-invoice-example.pdf for your procurement team to review.

3) Billing start / conversion trigger:
- Options: start billing on a fixed date after trial end OR switch to paid when usage exceeds an agreed threshold (e.g., sustained >100k tokens/day for 7 days).
- Ask: which approach does Acme prefer, and what threshold would you consider appropriate for auto-conversion?

4) Marketplace vs direct contract:
- If you want to go through AWS Marketplace (or GCP/Azure), that can simplify PO & commit handling but adds marketplace terms & timing.
- Aditya (cc'd) can share marketplace timelines/cut details.

Next steps: can you confirm (A) procurement contact name & email, (B) preferred billing path (PO vs card vs marketplace), and (C) target threshold/start date for billing?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-template.pdf, PO-invoice-example.pdf

From: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <emily.wong@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps

Thanks Marissa — great call. A few notes from procurement side: 

- Procurement contact: Emily Wong (emily.wong@acmecorp.com). She handles SaaS onboarding and PO processing.
- Preference: We prefer PO + monthly invoice for anything enterprise > $5k/month. For smaller pilots (< $5k/mo) we can use a corporate card.
- Marketplace: We prefer direct contract for speed on this pilot; marketplace adds 4–6 weeks with procurement review.

On conversion trigger: we like the usage-threshold approach. For this pilot, suggest auto-convert when usage exceeds 80k tokens/day sustained for 5 business days, or on an agreed date if we hit full evaluation sooner.

Doc/questions: can you send an SOW + initial quote with estimated monthly spend at the thresholds above? Also need standard SOC2 + data handling info for our compliance team.

Samir
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>, Emily Wong <emily.wong@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps

Samir — perfect, thanks for the clarity. I'll get an SOW + quote over today. A few clarifications so we size correctly: 

- Token assumptions: can you confirm whether your token estimate is 80k tokens/day of combined prompt+response or just prompt tokens? That affects cost projections.
- Trial duration: we typically recommend a 14-day trial for evaluation; do you want to start the trial next Monday (2026-04-20)?
- SOC2 & compliance: I'll attach our SOC2 summary and the public security FAQ; if Emily's team needs the full report we can arrange an NDA and a secure upload.

Aditya — can you confirm marketplace timelines and whether we can set a billing start date override if they opt for direct contract (so we don't auto-bill prematurely)?

I'll follow up with the SOW + quote and a one-page conversion checklist for procurement.

Thanks,
—Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps

Thanks Marissa / Samir — quick marketplace note:

- AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace typically adds 4–6 weeks because of procurement sequencing and revenue share approval processes. Not recommended if Acme wants a quick pilot.
- We can absolutely support PO invoicing on a direct contract; billing start date can be set to a future date (e.g., trial end + 1 day) or controlled manually by our billing ops to avoid premature charges.
- I'll send a short note to billing ops to flag ACME-2026-145 for manual handling so we can set the start date to 2026-05-04 if they pick the 14-day trial starting 2026-04-20.

-Aditya
VP, Business Development | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <emily.wong@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing next steps

All good — we want to start Monday 2026-04-20 with the 14-day pilot. Confirming: 

- Procurement: Emily (cc) will open PO process today.
- Conversion: auto-convert to paid if sustained >80k tokens/day (prompt+response) for 5 business days OR manual conversion on 2026-05-04 (billing start) if evaluation looks good.
- SOC2: Emily will let you know if an NDA is required for the full report.

Please send the SOW + quote and I'll route to procurement. Happy to schedule a 15-min call with Emily and our finance team if they have questions.

Thanks — Samir
